ORGANOID APPLICABILITY STUDY · ARCHIVAL IMAGES FROM RICKI

Review image quality on organoid imagery

These are the 18 images supplied in the 2023 folder and the 20 supplied in the 2024 folder. The 2024 cohort now uses the 20 original JPGs supplied subsequently; corrected versions are kept separately for paired comparison. They are separate from the current prototype's bead evaluation. No artificial blur, darkness or noise has been added here.

Judge the picture, not the organoid's health. Good means the target boundaries are sufficiently visible for your specified inspection. Bad means a technical image problem prevents that inspection. Unsure means you cannot make a reliable technical judgment. A dark organoid, irregular shape or visible fragments alone are not reasons to label image quality Bad.

1. Label original images before inspecting predictions

Previews preserve aspect ratio and are resized for display. Inspect the original PNG in your supplied folder if fine detail matters. Use Unsure if preview resolution prevents judgment. Quantitative features were computed from the as-provided PNGs at a documented analysis scale, not from these JPEG previews.

2. Optional reference-based application check

The full check needs a technically suitable reference for each imaging condition. A bead image is not an organoid reference. Year alone does not establish matching optics, exposure, scene or magnification. If no suitable matched reference exists, leave it unset: measurements and human review can still be exported, but full gate agreement will remain unavailable.

Finish labeling the selected cohort before showing its predictions. A selected reference must be labeled Good and is excluded from its evaluation denominator. The thresholds remain the prototype's provisional settings. Choosing references on these images makes this an exploratory applicability study, not independent final validation.

Original/processed paired comparison

The 20 corrected versions are not pooled with the originals. Open the paired viewer to inspect original and corrected versions of test21-test40. These are 20 scenes with two versions, not 40 independent scenes.

3. Export the review and context

The export preserves image IDs, original-file hashes, cohort, prior-processing note, feature values, your labels, references and context. It never infers healthy/unhealthy, cell death, intact/fragment class or pH. Predictions remain uncalibrated until reference assumptions and human agreement are evaluated. Download before closing; browser-local saving is best effort.
